Chapter 707: Chapter 12 Dimensionality Reduction (Please Subscribe)

“Great Destruction Rule Second Realm… achieved.”

Shortly after parting with the Xia Qin Supreme Being, Lin Yuan had comprehended the Great Destruction Rule to the Second Realm.

Any Tenth Rank Grade A powerhouse would be extremely thrilled once they realized a Pillar-grade Fusion Rules Dual Realm, wouldn’t they?

This meant that they could step into Tier 11.

In the Ten Thousand Races of the Cosmic Starry Sky, Eleventh-Rank Life was the strongest below Supreme Beings.

The ‘strongest’ here refers to all aspects, not merely strength.

...

For instance, mastering the Rule of Time?

It’s too tall an order for Tenth Rank Life to fully understand the Rule of Time; it’s an occurrence that hasn’t happened too many times since the universe began.

But for Eleventh-Rank Life wanting to master the Rule of Time… although still very difficult, it is at least much easier than for Tenth Rank Life.

Once the Rule of Time is mastered, it means a significant extension of lifespan.

By slowing down their own passage of time, one year for an Eleventh-Rank Life could equal thousands or even tens of thousands of years for a Tenth Rank Life.

However—

None of this had much significance for Lin Yuan.

Rule of Time? Lin Yuan had already mastered it at the Ninth Rank.

And even without mastering it, Lin Yuan didn’t care much about his own lifespan.

How old was he now? The longevity that those ancient Eleventh-Rank Lives yearned for, Lin Yuan now had in abundance.

As for cultivating the Great Destruction Rule to the Second Realm… in truth, gaining an additional Second Realm Fusion Rule did not enhance Lin Yuan’s strength as much as one might imagine.

After all, Lin Yuan’s current benchmark was against Eleventh Rank powerhouses. With his current foundation and techniques, even without realizing any Dual Realm Fusion Rules, he could still be considered invincible at the Tenth Rank.

And within the Eleventh Rank, realizing one Pillar-grade Fusion Rules Dual Realm was just a slight breakthrough.

“Next, the remaining four Pillar-grade Fusion Rules will also be cultivated to the Second Realm…” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

“And the Third Realm…” Lin Yuan pondered.

The most hopeful Rule for advancing to the Third Realm was the Life and Death Samsara Rule.

However, even with the black planet’s Guiding Space to study, Lin Yuan estimated that reaching the Third Realm would take him between one hundred to two hundred years.

As for the Fourth Realm? Not yet at the Third Realm, Lin Yuan didn’t know the extent to which he would have to go to reach the Fourth Realm, but it would not take more than five hundred years at most.

“To cultivate from the First Realm to the Fourth Realm, spending a little over seven hundred years is still acceptable,” Lin Yuan mused, nodding slightly to himself.

Seven hundred years is a blink of an eye to a Tenth Rank Evolver, but Lin Yuan could use that time to cultivate a Pillar-grade Fusion Rule to the Fourth Realm.

Lin Yuan was quite satisfied with that.

Moreover, in those seven hundred years, Lin Yuan would have comprehended not just one but six Pillar-grade Fusion Rules.

On top of that, new Pillar-grade Fusion Rules might be uncovered at any time, in addition to continual contemplation on the Rules of Time and Space, among other things.

“Where do I stand in the hierarchy of Eleventh-Rank Life with my current strength?” Lin Yuan suddenly wondered.

So far, the Starry Sky Races had divided Eleventh-Rank Life into six tiers.

The first tier of Eleventh-Rank Life had just entered Tier 11.

They had not yet mastered the Rule of Time.

The second tier was Eleventh-Rank Life that had mastered the Rule of Time.

The third tier was those who had cultivated a certain Pillar-grade Rule to the Fifth Realm.

The fourth tier was those who had fused time and space to understand the Space-Time Rule.

The fifth tier was those who had elevated the Space-Time Rule to the Fifth Realm.

The sixth tier represented those who had reached the pinnacle in all aspects and could attempt the ultimate breakthrough at any time.

Theoretically, an Eleventh-Rank Life at the fifth tier has the capability to strive for the ultimate, but the chances are slim, which is why there’s a sixth tier.

Even for Eleventh-Rank Life at the sixth tier, the probability of successfully making the ultimate breakthrough is very low.

To become ultimate, to break free from the shackles of the River of Time, to have infinite longevity, involves many aspects.

Throughout history, many peak Eleventh-Rank Lives favored by all sides ultimately failed in their attempt and vanished from existence.

Therefore, the various clans came to a conclusion.

Striving for the ultimate requires a certain ‘luck.’

Without ‘luck,’ no amount of preparation or sufficient foundation will help.

“Roughly the second tier,” Lin Yuan compared and concluded, positioning his current strength at the second tier within Tier 11.

An Eleventh-Rank Life at the third tier would have already cultivated a certain Pillar-grade Fusion Rule to the Fifth Realm, a level Lin Yuan couldn’t reach in the short term.

“If I could cultivate all twelve Pillar-grade Fusion Rules within the black planet to the Fourth Realm, I should be comparable to an Eleventh-Rank Life at the third tier.” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Third-tier Eleventh-Rank Life requires at least one Pillar-grade Fusion Rule cultivated to the Fifth Realm.

But twelve Fourth Realm Pillar-grade Fusion Rules would incite a qualitative change from the quantitative build-up, especially considering that the next six Pillar-grade Fusion Rules are not your average Pillar-grade.

They should be comparable to one Fifth Realm Pillar-grade Fusion Rule.

Of course.

The gap between Tenth Rank Life and Eleventh-Rank Life is far more than just the comprehension of Fusion Rules.

There are many other differences, such as the Physical Soul, Spirit Will, Inner World, and so on.

Normally.

Eleventh-Rank Life would have one more infusion of the Cosmic Origin Source than Tenth Rank Life, a gap as wide as a chasm.

But Lin Yuan’s reception of the Chaos Void Origin Infusion greatly bridged this gap, allowing him the possibility to be comparable to Eleventh-Rank Life.

…

Virtual World.

Lin Yuan was chatting leisurely with Nalan, the Vice Tower Master.

“Battlefield A098 is expected to see a marked increase in the intensity of the war. The Goddess of Freedom has already started the summoning, asking me to send an avatar there.”
